summary: Complete the apex API convergence by removing the legacy public API hostname from active Constitution, runtime references, Workers Custom Domains and exact Cloudflare DNS while keeping https://ekodi.kr/api as the only public API base.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed EKODI to continue the https://ekodi.kr/api structure under EKODI orchestration.
constitutionalInterpretation: This tightens the existing apex-path-only policy and does not expand authority. The Control Worker remains private behind CONTROL_API service binding; human sovereignty, guarded release, rollback and production verification remain unchanged.
implementedCapabilities: Active Constitution no longer registers a public API subdomain
Runtime and admin references converge on https://ekodi.kr/api
Retired API hostname cannot be reintroduced outside immutable history
Production release detaches the retired Workers Custom Domain
Production release removes any exact retired DNS record
Post-retirement verification proves the old hostname no longer serves first-party traffic
authorityImpact: None. This removes a public exposure and preserves existing permissions and security boundaries.
rollback: If canonical apex verification fails before retirement, guarded release restores the prior Worker version. After successful canonical verification and hostname retirement, rollback restores service code through the apex path only; the retired hostname is not recreated.
